snippet.title: Dude, Trust Me - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Three friends. Three different perspectives. One way out. 🎮

One is blind, one is deaf, and one can’t speak.

🏠 Explore different rooms
🧩 Solve different puzzles
📖 Decipher clues from the Escape Guide
🤝 Rely on your teammates to make it through
